description: Parity cases of the distinctive-name filter and of the extract reader (design D20): played against tools/sensitive_names.py (tests/sensitive_names/test_parite_texte.py) and against contract/src/noms.ts (contract/test/noms.test.ts). Invented labels only.

extract.text:
referential_teams:
  - name: Zorglub
  - name: "Quentin Duval"
  - name: 'Platform Team'
  - name: Zorglub
  - name: Generique Alpha
catalogue_teams:

other_section:
  - name: Ignored Name

parse.name: a byte-order mark, a comment, an empty line
two byte-order marks at the start
spaces and no-break spaces at the ends
a vertical tab and a form feed cut lines

extracts.name: CRLF
extracts.text:
referential_teams:
  - name: Zorglub
  - name: Nebula Crew

extracts.name: a lone carriage return
extracts.text: referential_teams:  - name: Zorglub  - name: Nebula Crew

extracts.name: case folding: the sharp s meets SS
extracts.text:
referential_teams:
  - name: Straße Crew
  - name: Zorglub
